game_title: Examination practice · Branch Assembly 8 · Merge Midpoint
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Sand Dunes – Dune Crest, a high dune crest: the desert nomad must handle sand wyrms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Program Assembler: Assemble a working program from shuffled code blocks in the right order.
theme: Sand Dunes – Dune Crest: a high dune crest
core_gameplay_loop: Construct a solution, execute it, inspect actual state and outputs, then revise until all mission goals pass.
player_objective: Week 5 examination practice: Source organization: build a valid C source file that prints 30. Put preprocessing before main; keep declarations and statements inside its body. Then test its compiler-factory route: Build the router at (3, 3), with the upper processing path on row 1 and lower path on row 6. IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Deliver exactly 15 components (7 upper, 8 lower). Set the gold-socket controller batch to 15.
controls: Drag sprites onto the grid. R rotates new pieces. Set fork output directions and router conditions in the inspector. Splitters alternate; routers evaluate each item; mergers accept one waiting item at a time fairly. Set batch size, connect power, repair rounded conveyors, then Run or Step. Grid controls are the keyboard alternative.
win_condition: The executed solution satisfies every output and world-state check.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Program Assembler' (Week 9 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Dune Crest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: C Components, Keywords, Preprocessor and Organization

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Read the objective, fixtures and command reference.
Build the circuit or route, or edit the node/adventure program.
Use Step to inspect state; Run checks the real outputs and goals.
Revise errors before using the remaining execution checks.
source_player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about program_ok to power up the desert nomad and open the oasis.
source_lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
hint: IF item value is even, send north to the upper branch; ELSE send south to the lower branch. Merge the two plate streams at (8, 3), then use the shared assembler and output. Branch contracts: IF: 7 components via upper_4, shared_assembler to output_shared; ELSE: 8 components via lower_4, shared_assembler to output_shared. Power the junctions and production machines. A blocked branch waits without losing items.
